Hi Susan —

Appreciate the note. Short answers up front: earliest invoice can go out 3 business days after receiving a signed PO if the account passes onboarding checks; net-45 is possible but needs finance approval and will affect revenue recognition timing (we'll call this out). See more detail below and I attached a checklist and a proposed PO timeline.

Key dependencies:
- PO received and signed (PDF or DocuSign)
- Legal playback complete (if custom terms) — usually 2 business days for standard SOWs
- Billing onboarding (tax form, billing contact) — up to 3 business days if all fields are provided

If all items are met, we can issue the invoice within 3 business days and recognize bookings on the invoice date. If net-45 is requested, finance will record the revenue deferral per GAAP and recognition will follow the agreed schedule (this can push recognition into the next month depending on timing).

Action items for Acme:
1) Upload signed PO to the shared Drive folder (ACME_PO_Timeline.xlsx is fine)
2) Confirm billing contact and remit address in the PO body
3) Flag net-45 in the PO if you require it (we will escalate to Finance)

Ben / Marissa — can you confirm Redwood's internal cutoffs for July bookings so we can tell Acme the latest PO-in-date to make July recognition?

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
